name: solute carrier family 44 member 1

function.text: SLC44A1 encodes choline transporter-like protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include choline transmembrane transporter activity and ethanolamine transmembrane transporter activity. It participates in choline transport and ethanolamine transport.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neurodegeneration, childhood-onset, with ataxia, tremor, optic atrophy, and cognitive decline (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
